terms.definition: The BTL sensory-feed hyperreality system delivered via jack lead, amplifying sensation and perception beyond baseline. The universal name for the experience across GLMZ; no other name is used.
A quality tier for cyberware and hardware, denoting mid-to-high-end manufacture above gray-market splice work but below flagship corporate-tier chrome.
A below-ground Gray Zone BTL den, one of many, where clients pay to jack into the Glass with a paired escort. Cheap, dim, and unglamorous compared to the aerostatic pleasure tiers.
